en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 11. He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ja’far reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi that Hammad ibn Isa said:
I requested Abul Hasan Musa ibn Ja’far, peace be upon him, saying: "May I be your ransom, pray to Allah that He may bless me with a son, and may not deprive me from Haj as long as I live."
He says: "He prayed for me and Allah gave me this son. And whenever the days of Haj arrived while I had no means for the expenses, Allah provided from unexpected quarters."
